name: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art
known: Founded by the collector Kiran Nadar, who has collected since 1988.
Named for its founder.
Nadar is Chairperson of the museum and a trustee of the Shiv Nadar Foundation.
She married Shiv Nadar, founder of HCL Technologies (Global Indian).
Leadership listed: Manuel Rabaté, Chief Executive Officer and Director.
Roobina Karode, Artistic Director and Chief Curator.

name: Lalit Kala Akademi
known: The collection was built from the Annual Exhibition, the Kala Mela art fair, workshops and camps, the Artists Aid Fund and the Chairman's Discretionary Funds (Akademi website).

name: National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA)
known: Hermann Goetz, a German art historian, was its first curator (Wikipedia).

name: Serendipity Arts Festival
known: Founded in 2016 by Sunil Kant Munjal, chairman of Hero Enterprise.
Sunil Kant Munjal is founder patron;

2025 festival partners page: "Supported By" the Government of Goa, the Sports Authority of Goa, the Directorate of Art and Culture, Kala Academy, Panjim Smart City, the Goa Forest Department and GTDC (stated by the festival).

name: Selasar Sunaryo Art Space
known: Founded by the artist Sunaryo, a former lecturer at the art and design faculty of the Bandung Institute of Technology, and opened on 5 September 1998 with his show "Titik Nadir", in which his works were covered in black cloth, which Manual calls "a sombre expression of the grief and uncertainty" of

The 25th-anniversary exhibition in 2023 included work by Sunaryo, his son Arin Dwihartanto Sunaryo and his daughter-in-law Syagini Ratna Wulan (Manual), so the founder's family is part of the programme.

name: Galeri Nasional Indonesia
known: It sits inside one public service agency (BLU) with other state museums; in April 2026 Culture Minister Fadli Zon said the gallery should ideally be run as its own BLU, and the head of Museums and Cultural Heritage, Indira Esti Nurjadin, said the units must keep raising non-tax state revenue (RRI).

name: Gudskul (ruangrupa / Serrum / Grafis Huru Hara)
known: Founder ruangrupa is listed among the organisations on the Arts Collaboratory site, whose only named funder is the DOEN Foundation;
Educational collective formed by ruangrupa (curators of documenta fifteen), Serrum and Grafis Huru Hara.

name: Museum MACAN
known: Founded by the businessman and collector Haryanto Adikoesoemo.

Director at opening: Aaron Seeto.
The museum is privately funded; director Aaron Seeto said "Even though we are privately funded" (Smithsonian Magazine).
It is run by a foundation chaired by Fenessa Adikoesoemo, daughter of Haryanto Adikoesoemo.
Wikipedia says he succeeded his father, AKR's founder Soegiarto Adikoesoemo, as president of AKR in 1992.

name: Cemeti - Institute for Art and Society
known: Directed by co-directors and chief curators Dito Yuwono and Mira Asriningtyas.
Under the Suharto regime the founders registered Cemeti as a small company, which let them avoid the government permission process for exhibitions (un Projects, Briony Galligan, 2013).
Its site names the Mondriaan Fund as a 2024 residency partner and shows five founders and staff.

name: Ruang MES 56
known: Wimo Ambala Bayang co-founded it with friends from ISI, the Indonesian Art Institute in Yogyakarta, and remains an active member (oddweb.org biographies).
